checks.description: Lambda functions must configure a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture failed asynchronous invocations
checks.impact: Without a DLQ, failed async Lambda invocations are silently dropped after AWS retries. Events are permanently lost with no visibility, violating audit requirements and breaking downstream event-driven workflows
checks.resolution: Add a dead_letter_config block to the aws_lambda_function resource with target_arn pointing to an SQS queue or SNS topic
checks.errorMessage: Lambda function does not have a dead_letter_config block — failed async invocations will be silently dropped
